Definition: a skull (as round); by implication, a head (in enumeration of persons)
BiblicalUsage: gulgôleth is a plain word for a skull, a head. In Exodus 16:16, the text says "according to] the number of your persons." In Judges 9:53, the text says "And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading gulgôleth this way, I believe death is real, but it is not the end — God has the last word over it. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Abimelech's Rise and Fall; Jehu's Purge of Ahab's House; Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
